name: trajectory
description: A Hermes-style trajectory pane: every system, user, context, assistant and tool row of the session on one timeline, with a minimap and search

skipManagedHooks.title: Skip hooks an organization passes over
skipManagedHooks.description: Leave prompt.compose, prompt.context and session.append unhooked: the pane reads the prompt, memory files and transcript instead. Turned on by itself where cc-plugin-sec-default is loaded.
